/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.after: Benefits of Traveling Light in Egypt
/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.text: Packages such as our [7-day Cairo and Hurghada holiday](/packages/7-days-cairo-hurghada-holiday/) include a domestic flight, so check the baggage allowance on your ticket before you pack.

/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.after: Red Sea Coast: Beach Bliss and Snorkeling Wonders
/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.text: Staying in Hurghada? The [Orange Bay island snorkeling trip](/tours/orange-bay-island-snorkeling/) provides masks, snorkels, life jackets and lunch on board, so a swimsuit, towel and reef-safe sunscreen are all you need to bring.

/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.after: How Can You Pack Lighter for Egypt?
/blog/egypt-packing-light-essential-guid.text: A Nile cruise makes light packing even easier: on our [4-day cruise from Aswan to Luxor](/nile-cruises/4-days-nile-cruise-aswan-to-luxor/), your cabin travels with you, so you unpack once for all three nights.

/blog/egypt-packing-list-essential-items.text: Booked the [Luxor hot air balloon](/tours/luxor-hot-air-balloon/)? Add a warm layer and flat, closed shoes: the flight starts before sunrise, when desert mornings can be cold, especially from November to February.

/blog/egypt-packing-list-essential-items.after: What Extra Gear Is Worth Packing for Egypt?
/blog/egypt-packing-list-essential-items.text: Your own snorkel set is optional on organized boat trips: the [Orange Bay snorkeling trip](/tours/orange-bay-island-snorkeling/) from Hurghada and the [Ras Mohammed snorkeling trip](/tours/ras-mohammed-snorkeling/) from Sharm El Sheikh both provide equipment and life jackets on board.

/blog/egypt-photography-tips-travel-came.text: Because our [Giza Pyramids and Saqqara tour](/tours/giza-pyramids-saqqara-tour/) is private, you can plan the timing with your guide to catch softer light on the plateau and quieter moments at the Step Pyramid.

/blog/egypt-photography-tips-travel-came.after: Temple Photography: Luxor, Karnak, and Abu Simbel
/blog/egypt-photography-tips-travel-came.text: At [Abu Simbel](/tours/abu-simbel-temples-private-tour/), the temples face east toward the rising sun, so early-morning light is best for the colossal statues of Ramses II.

/blog/egypt-photography-tips-travel-came.after: How Can You Take Better Travel Photos in Egypt?
/blog/egypt-photography-tips-travel-came.text: For aerial shots, nothing beats a sunrise [Luxor hot air balloon](/tours/luxor-hot-air-balloon/) flight over the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the green fields along the Nile.

/blog/egypt-sim-card-tourist-guide-nile-.after: Why Buy an Egypt SIM Card as a Tourist?
/blog/egypt-sim-card-tourist-guide-nile-.text: Mobile data also makes long days easier, letting you stay in touch with your driver and guide on WhatsApp during trips such as the [Luxor day trip from Hurghada](/tours/luxor-day-trip-from-hurghada/).

/blog/egypt-sim-card-tourist-guide-nile-.after: Is There Wi-Fi on a Nile Cruise?
/blog/egypt-sim-card-tourist-guide-nile-.text: If you are sailing with us on the [4-day cruise from Aswan to Luxor](/nile-cruises/4-days-nile-cruise-aswan-to-luxor/) or the [5-day cruise from Luxor to Aswan](/nile-cruises/5-days-nile-river-cruise-from-luxor-to-aswan/), a local SIM keeps you connected on sailing days, when onboard Wi-Fi tends to be weakest.

/blog/nubian-village-tour-aswan-nightlif.after: Why Take a Nubian Village Tour in Aswan?
/blog/nubian-village-tour-aswan-nightlif.text: A village visit fits easily into a Nile cruise: our [5-day cruise from Luxor to Aswan](/nile-cruises/5-days-nile-river-cruise-from-luxor-to-aswan/) ends in Aswan, and the [4-day cruise from Aswan to Luxor](/nile-cruises/4-days-nile-cruise-aswan-to-luxor/) starts there.

/blog/nubian-village-tour-aswan-nightlif.after: What Is the Boat Ride to the Nubian Villages Like?
/blog/nubian-village-tour-aswan-nightlif.text: Visiting [Abu Simbel](/tours/abu-simbel-temples-private-tour/) the same day? The early-morning trip is back in Aswan by the afternoon, in time for a sunset boat ride to the villages.

/blog/siwa-oasis-egypt-hidden-gems-adven.after: How Do You Get to Siwa Oasis?
/blog/siwa-oasis-egypt-hidden-gems-adven.text: Since most Siwa trips start and end in Cairo, it is worth adding a few days in the capital, for example with our [private 4-day Cairo tour package](/packages/private-4-days-cairo-tour-package/), which covers the Giza pyramids, Saqqara and Old Cairo.

/blog/siwa-oasis-egypt-hidden-gems-adven.after: Fayoum Oasis: Ancient Canals and Desert Magic
/blog/siwa-oasis-egypt-hidden-gems-adven.text: Fayoum's Meidum Pyramid, one of Egypt's early attempts at a true pyramid, pairs well with our [Saqqara, Memphis and Dahshur day trip](/tours/saqqara-memphis-dahshur-day-trip-from-cairo/), where the Bent and Red Pyramids show how the builders finally succeeded.

/blog/aswan-egypt-guide-temples-nubian-v.after: How Do You Get to Aswan and Get Around?
/blog/aswan-egypt-guide-temples-nubian-v.text: The most scenic way to arrive is by river: our [5-day Nile cruise from Luxor to Aswan](/nile-cruises/5-days-nile-river-cruise-from-luxor-to-aswan/) visits Edfu and Kom Ombo on the way and ends with Aswan's High Dam, Unfinished Obelisk and Philae Temple.

/blog/egyptian-food-guide-authentic-flav.after: Savoring Nubian Cuisine in Upper Egypt
/blog/egyptian-food-guide-authentic-flav.text: You can taste many of these dishes on our tours: the [Luxor day trip from Hurghada](/tours/luxor-day-trip-from-hurghada/) includes lunch at a local restaurant, and the [Giza Pyramids and Saqqara tour](/tours/giza-pyramids-saqqara-tour/) has an optional lunch stop serving Egyptian food.

/blog/luxor-egypt-travel-guide-temples-b.after: What Is There to See on Luxor's West Bank?
/blog/luxor-egypt-travel-guide-temples-b.text: Short on time? Our [Luxor day trip from Hurghada](/tours/luxor-day-trip-from-hurghada/) covers Karnak, the Valley of the Kings, the Temple of Hatshepsut and the Colossi of Memnon in one day, while the [4-day Nile cruise from Aswan to Luxor](/nile-cruises/4-days-nile-cruise-aswan-to-luxor/) ends with guided visits to both banks of Luxor.
